I made the change, and the full suite passes: 665 tests in 15 files, including all 44 in `test/ufo-drive-letters-confirmed.test.ts` and all 154 in the hidden suite.

`parseURL` in `src/parse.ts` didn't throw `not implemented`. It still had the old code, which removed the `/` before a drive letter for every URL. I changed one line so that removal only happens when the protocol is exactly `file:` as written in the input:

```ts
protocol === "file:" ? path.replace(/\/(?=[A-Za-z]:)/, "") : path,
```

The protocol is checked before it is lowercased, so `FILE:` and `File:` keep the `/C:/x` pathname, as the spec requires. Protocol-relative URLs have no protocol, so they aren't normalized either. A `defaultProto` of `"file://"` produces a URL starting with `file:`, so it is normalized, while `"FILE://"` is not. Everything else in `parseURL` is unchanged, and so is every other export.
